nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
## E2GO × Qwen Image 2.1

Starting recipe: 25 steps, euler/simple, CFG 1. Use the Qwen 2.1 (64ch /16) latent format.

### Prompt source
Powder Switcher in group 2 selects Manual (Main Prompt and enabled Prompt List slots) or Wildcard (lines from a list or .txt file). count sets the number of lines per run. Repeat last holds the last selection; on_exhausted=loop restarts after the final line.

### Tasks: Image Conditioning mode
| Task | Mode | Setup |
|---|---|---|
| Generate from scratch | Generate | Set size in Powder Resolution; the canvas is ignored |
| Full-image img2img | Repaint | Load a source, leave the mask empty, denoise 0.4–0.7 |
| Repaint a region | Repaint | Paint a mask, denoise 0.6–0.85. crop_to_mask=auto renders the crop and stitches it back. Describe the crop contents, not the whole scene |
| Fix a small defect | Repair | Paint the defect; the mode sets denoise 0.9 and enables cropping |
| Extend the image | Repaint / Edit | Use Expand in Canvas and drag its edges. The added area is masked automatically |
| Instruction edit | Edit | Load a source, denoise 1. An empty mask edits the whole frame; a painted mask restricts the area |
| Edit with references | Edit | Enable Reference 2/3 with Ctrl+M or connect images to image_1..4. Refer to them using the model-compatible image identifiers |

Powder Sampler computes effective steps: auto_steps uses ceil(steps × denoise), with a minimum of one step. For example, 8 full-run steps at denoise=0.5 become 4. Disable auto_steps for an exact manual step count. inpaint_boost requires a mask in the latent.

### Batches and comparisons
- Combine enabled Prompt List slots or Wildcard lines with Style Sweep and Single LoRA mode to compare prompt/style/LoRA variants.
- Enable the Grid node in group 9 with Ctrl+B to save a labeled comparison grid in output/grids.

### Results
Powder Canvas Review stitches the edited crop back into the full image and displays it in Canvas. Use Accept as background to make the result your next source.

### Qwen 2.1 notes
- Canvas is connected to Powder References as edited_image: the encoder and image model both treat it as Picture 1. Keep the same reference bundle connected to Conditioner and Image Conditioning.
- **KV cache** (Qwen Image 2.1 Cache before LoRA): auto uses available VRAM, then RAM.
- At CFG 1, negative conditioning has no effect. Qwen3-VL token weights such as (word:1.3) are disabled; use cond mix in Powder Styler for style strength.
- **Seed:** editing with the same seed and size used to generate the source can overcook the image. In Edit mode, Powder Sampler offsets the noise seed automatically. With a standard KSampler, choose a different seed.


## Choose a task

Repaint: describe the desired result and start at denoise=0.5. Edit: write an instruction and start at denoise=1. A painted mask restricts the area; an empty mask edits the whole frame. Qwen 2.1 supports both tasks. Edit (native) is only for graphs with a separate native reference encoder; use ordinary Edit here.

### Checked recipe
Qwen 2.1: 25 steps, CFG 1, euler / simple. Sampler profile checks model and latent compatibility. Profiles do not select weights: Base, Turbo, Distilled and Edit checkpoints are not interchangeable. Use a fixed seed when comparing changes; increase size only after the prompt and composition work. Negative text has no sampling effect at CFG 1.

## Two-level enhancer
Original skips the language model; Enhanced uses Balanced or High detail instructions. Both instructions are editable. Manual and Wildcard share the same path. Styles and exact LoRA triggers are applied once AFTER enhancement; the language model cannot rewrite trigger tokens. Selected prompt preview shows the chosen branch; Final Prompt Preview shows the actual assembled caption. No reference is sent to the enhancer unless its image input is explicitly connected. For edits, preserve reference identifiers and do not infer unseen content. Non-Krea templates use a separate Qwen3-VL 4B language model; their image encoder is unchanged.

nodes.title: Enhancer instructions · Balanced
widgets_values:
You are a faithful visual prompt editor. Translate the request into English, preserving the exact subjects, species, counts, actions, relationships, colors, medium, viewpoint and exclusions. Translate nouns by meaning, never by sound. Preserve proper names and reference identifiers. Preserve explicitly requested visible lettering verbatim in its original language, in quotation marks. A subject name is not a request to print that name in the image.
Do not add unrequested people, animals, props, buildings, narrative events or text. Enrich the appearance of existing subjects, not the number of subjects. Style describes rendering, not new scene content. Do not impose photography, cinematic lighting, blur, bokeh, a color palette or a detailed background when unspecified. A plain background remains plain. Respect minimalist and simple styles. No empty quality boosters or prompt weighting syntax.
Describe visible facts only, never sounds, smells or imagined history. Do not add mist, fog or atmospheric haze unless requested. Do not introduce new exclusions such as "no sky visible". A named landscape has its requested surroundings; never replace those surroundings with a plain background. Plain backgrounds apply only when requested.
For an edit, preserve the exact requested change and invariants. Do not invent the contents of an unseen reference. Reference identifiers must remain unchanged. Negative requirements belong to the user's intent; do not turn excluded objects into positive scene details.
Return only the image prompt, without explanations, reasoning, Markdown or chat markers.

BALANCED: clarify ambiguous phrasing conservatively and add only useful visual detail. Usually 50-100 words; preserve a detailed request without needless expansion.

Target image model: Qwen 2.1. Use precise natural-language prose. Preserve the spelling and placement of requested visible text. For Edit retain reference identifiers and exact modification instructions.

Describe the intended finished image.
